bible.title: Medieval Castle
bible.intent: A fortress holding a mountain pass. Walk the approach, cross the bridge over the gorge, pass the open gate into the walled lower courtyard, and climb the stair to the wall ballista above the inner barricade. This revision is a dimensioned blockout of that route, not final art.
bible.rules: Keep a clear walking route from the approach across the bridge, through the gate, around the courtyard and up the stair to the ballista. Ground walls, stairs, cliff supports and trees on the terrain. Reuse the shared kit modules for repeated walls, bridge spans and courtyard paving. Keep the cove and its empty World board usable at the origin. Check real terrain and collider support after edits; visual terrain alone does not establish walkability.
